messages:
sam: Found partner SA JSON inside nightly backup (KMS-wrapped). Marking as potential exfil, treating as incident. Please keep chatter minimal. :rotating_light:

vault-bot: secret-scan v2.7 flagged object; incident created INC-6112233444; sha256=deadbeefcafefeed

anya: Immediate actions: 1) snapshot IAM + KMS metadata, 2) block SA key creation for partner, 3) schedule KMS rewrap during infra window. I can lead rotation if infra confirms window.

infra-oncall: Confirmed maintenance window 03:10-03:40 UTC. We'll provide a helper VM with access to rewrap tooling.

sam: Snapshot cmds (example):
#gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-prod > iam-6112233444.json
#gcloud logging read 'resource.type=project AND timestamp>"2026-04-01T00:00:00Z"' --limit=1000 > audit-6112233444.log
#aws kms describe-key --key-id alias/backup-key --profile infra > kms-meta.txt
Also upload originals to s3://redwood-incident-audit/6112233444/ (do not delete).

compliance: Preserve audit logs and metadata; do not send any external notice until legal signs off.

anya: Opening runbook PR and will ping legal. Will post short status updates here (status, ETA, blockers).
